title: Branch protection, merge policy, and native secret scanning on main
summary: Owner configures the repository so that only the Coordinator (through the Owner's account) can merge to main, every merge needs a PR with green required checks and a Code Owner review, and GitHub's native secret scanning with push protection is on.

acceptance_tests.test: main requires a pull request; direct pushes are rejected for everyone including administrators ('Do not allow bypassing the above settings').

Required status checks: `gitleaks`, `repo hygiene (env files, keys, raw media, size)`, `lint gate`, `tickets validate`, `movement.json single source of truth`, `protected paths need APPROVED #n`, `unity tests gate`, `android build gate`.
Require review from Code Owners (1 approval); dismiss stale approvals on new pushes; no force pushes; no deletions.
Secret scanning and push protection are enabled (free on a public repository).
A push to main by the Bot machine user is rejected (evidence: the rejected push output, redacted).
